meta.name: checkpoint
meta.description: Mid-task rollback points — save/restore state before risky ops (refactors, migrations, destructive edits). For end-of-session save use `/handoff`. Triggers "checkpoint", "snapshot", "before this risky op", "rollback to", "list checkpoints", pre-refactor save.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在风险操作前保存状态，随时回滚恢复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常进行高风险代码修改，需要安全网
copy.tagline_en: Save state before risky ops and roll back when needed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often perform risky code changes and need a safety net

howto.what: 允许你在重大操作前保存当前工作状态（创建检查点），之后可随时恢复到任一保存的状态。
howto.when: 当你提到“checkpoint”、“snapshot”、“rollback”、“list checkpoints”等关键词，或准备进行重构、迁移等风险操作时触发。

say.note: 创建新检查点并可选添加标签。
显示当前项目的检查点列表。
恢复文件到最新检查点保存时的状态，未追踪文件不受影响。

howto.what_en: Allows you to save the current working state (create a checkpoint) before risky operations, and later restore to any saved state. Restore works on tracked files only.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'checkpoint', 'snapshot', 'rollback', 'list checkpoints', or before performing risky operations like refactors or migrations.

say_en.note: Creates a new checkpoint with optional label.
Shows all checkpoints for the current project.
